verdict.rationale: Luma has a public API with SDKs, an llms.txt index, and markdown versions of its doc pages (luma-docs-3, luma-docs-4, luma-probe-1). Those are adjacent AI-friendly documentation features, not a machine-readable API spec. Probes of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404 (luma-probe-2), and nothing in the pack documents a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec.
